marketplace.heroEyebrow: For university labs, investors and industry
marketplace.heroTitle: Fund research without selling the patent.
marketplace.heroText: BioLicensing turns a university patent into a licence on Stellar: funded in euros, released milestone by milestone, with royalties shared automatically.
marketplace.title: Licences on Stellar

licence.title: A licence, not a sale
licence.text: The university keeps the patent. Investors fund a licence whose terms and dossier fingerprint are recorded on-chain.

milestones.title: Paid by milestones
milestones.text: EURC stays in escrow and is released only when the lab proves each milestone. The investor can dispute.

royalties.title: Royalties shared automatically
royalties.text: One payment from the licensee is split between the university, its inventors and investors.

marketplace.emptyText: A university lists a patent in three short steps. The first licence will appear here.

newLicence.splitOk: Total 100 %: every royalty is fully shared

newLicence.title: List a patent
newLicence.intro: Your university stays the owner: you publish a licence, not the patent. Fill in 3 short sections, then confirm 3 times in your wallet.
newLicence.card1Subtitle: The terms an industrial partner will see.
newLicence.exclusiveText: A single industrial partner can use the patent.
newLicence.nonExclusiveText: Several partners can license it in parallel.
newLicence.card2Subtitle: Your dossier stays private; only its fingerprint is public.
newLicence.chooseDossier: Choose the scientific dossier (PDF, any file)
newLicence.dossierText: It is fingerprinted in your browser and never uploaded. Anyone can later check a copy against the fingerprint stored on Stellar.
newLicence.dataRoomHint: Revealed only to people who sign the NDA on-chain.
newLicence.card3Title: How is it funded and who earns what?
newLicence.card3Subtitle: Funds are released step by step; royalties are shared automatically.
newLicence.investorHint: Must have passed KYC on the platform.
newLicence.arbiterHint: Decides if the investor disputes a milestone.
newLicence.milestonesHint: Each amount is paid to the lab once you prove that milestone, in order.
newLicence.window: Time the investor has to dispute a milestone
newLicence.walletWillAsk: Your wallet will ask you to confirm:

licence.dataRoomText: The full dossier stays encrypted off-chain. Signing the confidentiality agreement is recorded on Stellar before access is granted.

licence.noDataRoom: No data room link provided by the university.

licence.windowClosed: Challenge window closed with no dispute: anyone can release the funds.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.intro: Only verified institutions can list patents, and only investors who passed KYC can hold revenue shares.
admin.notAdmin: Connect the platform admin account to change these registries. Anyone can look up a status.
admin.institutionsText: Universities, labs and tech transfer offices allowed to mint licences.
admin.kycText: Investors allowed to hold, buy or sell revenue shares.

hints.native: Every testnet account already holds XLM from Friendbot.

cashOut.title: Cash out to a bank account
cashOut.intro: Milestone funds and royalties arrive on Stellar. A regulated anchor turns them into a bank transfer: the lab never has to deal with crypto.
cashOut.testnetNote: Testnet: this demo uses the Stellar reference anchor ({{domain}}). It does not list EURC and sends no real money, so the withdrawal runs with one of the assets it supports. In production the same SEP-24 flow points at an anchor that converts EURC into a SEPA transfer.
cashOut.connect: Connect the lab's wallet to cash out.
cashOut.windowHint: The anchor opens a window to collect the amount and bank details.
